findings.evidence: generate_room_specs creates and places room specifications; resize_room modifies dimensions, add_door/add_window operate on resulting walls.
findings.scope: This is a separate floor-plan stage, not an exposed in-place partition edit on the imported supplied shell.

findings.evidence: generate_wall_assets/place_wall_object/move_wall_object/remove_wall_object operate on mounted wall objects, not architectural interior wall geometry.
Only query/add/move/remove/facing native furniture tools; fixed shell, ground templates, no rescale or articulation.
findings.remaining: Static screen geometry may provide visual obstruction, but no measured opacity, enclosure, plumbing or installation acceptance.

decision: Proceed with one entire-room development baseline with explicit capability limits. Failure or unknown sanitary privacy remains a result; do not substitute procedural walls or claim screen equals bathroom.
